image_description: An underwater photograph showing a hammerhead shark swimming over a sandy seabed with scattered rocks. The image has low resolution, significant blur, and a reddish digital timestamp in the bottom right corner. The shark is viewed from above and slightly behind, displaying its characteristic T-shaped head, dorsal fin, pectoral fins, and tail.
